description: This file contains utility macros and template functions for validation, including checks for unique IDs within ranges, and finding disconnected IDs in resource sets. It is part of the 'ocudu' namespace and references validation result handling.

methods.name: has_unique_ids
methods.description: Checks if all elements in a range have a unique ID, using a provided callback.

methods.name: has_unique_ids
methods.description: Checks if all elements in a range have a unique ID, accessed via a member pointer.

methods.name: are_all_unique
methods.description: Checks if all elements in a range are unique.

methods.name: find_disconnected_id
methods.description: Finds an ID in a set of resource sets that is not present in a given resource list.
